people-w1-accept-partial.ref: statenour/people-w1-accept-partial (job 2026-10-30-people-tracker; manager order 2026-10-31: the --plan resume reached 89 of 92 and 3 conversations fail the digest on every pass). --accept-partial (a --plan flag; refused with exit 2 elsewhere, before any connection) writes the plan file and its token for the digested set when the run ends partial: the file is { partial: { done, total, undigested: [conversation ids] }, rows } (ids only), the token covers the header, and it prints 'partial accepted: N of M' and the undigested ids. A complete run still writes the plain list. deserializePlan reads both forms and validates the header; --execute prints the header, and runApply applies a partial plan's rows (the consumer end, tested). The progress file format is unchanged, so the manager's existing progress file resumes as is. Red first: the flag parse, the header round trip and token, the malformed header. 3 backfill test files, 46 tests; scoped script tsc exit 0.
